title: analyze_gaps gap-coordinate back-projection error
lines: 482-484 (rc = row_centers[ri]; exp_lx = cx + exp_along*cos_a - (rc-cy)*sin_a; exp_ly = cy + exp_along*sin_a + (rc-cy)*cos_a)
bug: uses (rc - cy) where rc is the row center in ACROSS units; correct inverse rotation requires rc (image: y = cy + along*sin + rc*cos)
impact: Gap COUNT and slot selection are correct; gap POSITIONS are systematically displaced by cy (mean-y of plant set) along the across axis. Real sessions with hundreds of plants: cy can be thousands of px -> gaps can be placed on the wrong row or outside the field in local GeoJSON/SHP. Affects gap outputs only; runtime/aircraft safety not affected.
